note: Votes on the controls of the unit, collected once and reused in every round of the unit. Each vote is one fresh agent that received one picture and the question of R2 and nothing else. The pictures are the approved pictures of the unit, resized and encoded like the judged images (1398 x 786 PNG, no metadata). Each juror sent its one line to a clerk agent that saved it unchanged; the lines are read from those files by a script. The Reveal has four approved pictures (reveal-1 to reveal-4), so 20 votes. Only 5 of the 20 took an approved picture of the Reveal for a photograph or a film frame; 15 answered an ordinary 3D render. By the rule of R2 the judged frames are held to these pictures, not to an absolute.
